/* ── Config ── */
const BASE='/careconnected/wp-json/wp/v2';
let NONCE='',UID=0,UNAME='';

/* ── State ── */
let S={loading:true,groups:[],gid:null,tab:'home',members:[],tasks:[],posts:[],gallery:[],messages:[],invites:[],caredOnes:[],dlg:null,dlgData:{},toast:null,dropdown:null};

/* ── API ── */
async function api(p,m,b){
  m=m||'GET';const o={method:m,credentials:'same-origin',headers:{'X-WP-Nonce':NONCE,'Content-Type':'application/json'}};
  if(b&&m!=='GET')o.body=JSON.stringify(b);
  const r=await fetch(BASE+p,o);
  if(m==='DELETE')return {};
  if(!r.ok){const t=await r.text();throw new Error(t);}
  return r.json();
}

function toast(msg){S.toast=msg;render();setTimeout(()=>{S.toast=null;render();},3000);}
function fdate(d){if(!d)return '';try{return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en',{month:'short',day:'numeric'});}catch(e){return '';}}
function ftime(d){if(!d)return '';try{return new Date(d).toLocaleTimeString('en',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit'});}catch(e){return '';}}
function genCode(){return Math.random().toString(36).substring(2,8).toUpperCase();}
function gm(item,key){return (item.acf&&item.acf[key]!=null)?item.acf[key]:((item.meta&&item.meta[key]!=null)?item.meta[key]:'');}

/* ── Data Loading ── */
async function init(){
  try{
    const scripts=document.querySelectorAll('script');
    for(const sc of scripts){if(sc.textContent&&sc.textContent.includes('wpApiSettings')){const m=sc.textContent.match(/"nonce":"([^"]+)"/);if(m)NONCE=m[1];}}
    if(!NONCE&&typeof wpApiSettings!=='undefined')NONCE=wpApiSettings.nonce;
    if(!NONCE){const pg=document.querySelector('#wp-api-fetch-js-extra');if(pg){const m2=pg.textContent.match(/"nonce":"([^"]+)"/);if(m2)NONCE=m2[1];}}
    if(!NONCE){/* try fetching nonce from rest url */try{const r=await fetch('/careconnected/wp-json/',{credentials:'same-origin'});const h=document.cookie;}catch(e){}}
  }catch(e){}
  try{const me=await api('/users/me?context=edit');UID=me.id;UNAME=me.name||'';}catch(e){}
  await loadGroups();
  S.loading=false;render();
}

async function loadGroups(){
  try{
    const gs=await api('/care_group?per_page=100&status=publish');
    S.groups=gs.map(g=>({id:g.id,name:g.title?g.title.rendered:'',description:gm(g,'description'),join_code:gm(g,'join_code'),is_private:gm(g,'is_private'),author:g.author}));
    if(S.groups.length&&!S.gid)S.gid=S.groups[0].id;
    if(S.gid)await loadGroupData();
  }catch(e){S.groups=[];}
}

async function loadGroupData(){
  const gid=S.gid;if(!gid)return;
  const [mem,tsk,pst,gal,msg,inv]=await Promise.all([
    api('/care_group_member?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_task?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_group_post?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_group_gallery?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_group_message?per_page=100&status=publish&orderby=date&order=asc').catch(()=>[]),
    api('/care_group_invite?per_page=100&status=publish').catch(()=>[])
  ]);
  S.members=mem.filter(m=>String(gidOf(m))===String(gid)).map(m=>({id:m.id,user_id:uidOf(m),is_owner:String(gm(m,'is_owner'))==='1',is_admin:String(gm(m,'is_admin'))==='1',is_cared_one:String(gm(m,'is_cared_one'))==='1',name:m.title?m.title.rendered:gm(m,'member_name')||'Member',email:gm(m,'email')}));
  S.tasks=tsk.filter(t=>String(gm(t,'care_group'))===String(gid)).map(t=>({id:t.id,title:t.title?t.title.rendered:'',description:gm(t,'description'),status:gm(t,'status')||'pending',priority:gm(t,'priority')||'medium',category:gm(t,'category'),due_date:gm(t,'due_date'),assigned_to:gm(t,'assigned_to'),created_by:t.author}));
  S.posts=pst.filter(p=>String(gidOf(p))===String(gid)).map(p=>({id:p.id,title:p.title?p.title.rendered:'',content:gm(p,'content')||p.content?.rendered||'',type:gm(p,'post_type')||gm(p,'post_type_filter')||'discussion',is_pinned:String(gm(p,'is_pinned'))==='1',visibility:gm(p,'visibility')||'group',author_name:gm(p,'author_name')||UNAME,author_id:p.author,created_at:p.date}));
  S.gallery=gal.filter(g=>String(gidOf(g))===String(gid)).map(g=>({id:g.id,image_url:gm(g,'image_url'),caption:gm(g,'caption')||g.title?.rendered||''}));
  S.messages=msg.filter(m=>String(gidOf(m))===String(gid)).map(m=>({id:m.id,content:gm(m,'message_content')||gm(m,'content'),sender_id:gm(m,'sender_id')||gm(m,'sender_wp_user_id')||m.author,sender_name:gm(m,'sender_name')||'Member',created_at:m.date}));
  S.invites=inv.filter(i=>String(gidOf(i))===String(gid)&&(gm(i,'status')==='pending'||gm(i,'invite_status')==='pending')).map(i=>({id:i.id,email:gm(i,'invitee_email')||gm(i,'invite_email'),created_at:i.date}));
}

function gidOf(item){return gm(item,'group_id')||gm(item,'care_group_id')||gm(item,'care_group');}
function uidOf(item){return gm(item,'user_id')||gm(item,'user_wp_id')||gm(item,'author_wp_id');}

/* ── CRUD Operations ── */
async function createGroup(name,desc){
  const code=genCode();
  const g=await api('/care_group','POST',{title:name,status:'publish',meta:{description:desc||'',join_code:code,is_private:'0',created_by_wp_id:String(UID)}});
  // Add creator as owner member
  await api('/care_group_member','POST',{title:UNAME||'Owner',status:'publish',meta:{group_id:String(g.id),care_group_id:String(g.id),user_id:String(UID),user_wp_id:String(UID),member_name:UNAME,is_admin:'1',is_owner:'1',is_cared_one:'0'}});
  S.gid=g.id;await loadGroups();toast('Care Group created!');render();
}
async function joinByCode(code){
  const g=S.groups.find(g=>g.join_code&&g.join_code.toUpperCase()===code.toUpperCase());
  if(!g){/* search all groups */const all=await api('/care_group?per_page=100&status=publish');const found=all.find(a=>gm(a,'join_code')&&gm(a,'join_code').toUpperCase()===code.toUpperCase());
    if(!found)throw new Error('Invalid join code');
    await api('/care_group_member','POST',{title:UNAME||'Member',status:'publish',meta:{group_id:String(found.id),care_group_id:String(found.id),user_id:String(UID),user_wp_id:String(UID),member_name:UNAME,is_admin:'0',is_owner:'0',is_cared_one:'0'}});
    S.gid=found.id;
  }else{
    const existing=S.members.find(m=>String(m.user_id)===String(UID));

    h+='<div class="mb6"><h3 style="font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.75rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem">'+ic('clock',16)+' <span style="color:var(--WN)">Pending Invitations ('+S.invites.length+')</span></h3><div class="sy2">';
    S.invites.forEach(inv=>{
      h+='<div class="ccard" style="padding:.75rem;border-left:3px solid var(--WN)"><div class="cbet"><div><p style="font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500">'+(inv.email||'Unknown')+'</p><p style="font-size:.75rem;color:var(--M)">Invited '+fdate(inv.created_at)+'</p></div>';
      h+='<button class="cbtn cb-ghost cb-sm" style="color:var(--DN)" data-cancelinv="'+inv.id+'">'+ic('x',16)+' Cancel</button></div></div>';
    });

  // Active members
  h+='<div><h3 style="font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.75rem">Active Members ('+S.members.length+')</h3><div class="sy2">';
  S.members.forEach(m=>{
    h+='<div class="ccard" style="padding:1rem"><div class="cbet"><div class="cflex g3">';
    h+='<div class="cav">'+(m.name||'?')[0].toUpperCase()+'</div><div>';
    h+='<p style="font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500">'+(m.name||'Member')+'</p>';
    if(m.email)h+='<p style="font-size:.75rem;color:var(--M)">'+m.email+'</p>';
    h+='<div class="cflex g1" style="margin-top:.25rem;flex-wrap:wrap">';
    if(m.is_owner)h+='<span class="cbadge cbd" style="font-size:.625rem;padding:.0625rem .375rem">'+ic('crown',10)+' Owner</span>';
    if(m.is_admin&&!m.is_owner)h+='<span class="cbadge cbs" style="font-size:.625rem;padding:.0625rem .375rem">'+ic('shield',10)+' Admin</span>';
    if(m.is_cared_one)h+='<span class="cbadge" style="font-size:.625rem;padding:.0625rem .375rem;background:rgba(232,118,75,.1);color:var(--P)">'+ic('heart',10)+' Cared One</span>';
    if(!m.is_owner&&!m.is_admin&&!m.is_cared_one)h+='<span class="cbadge cbo" style="font-size:.625rem;padding:.0625rem .375rem">Member</span>';
    h+='</div></div></div>';
    if(isAdmin()&&String(m.user_id)!==String(UID)){
      h+='<div class="cdrop"><button class="cbtn cb-ghost cb-icon" data-membermenu="'+m.id+'">'+ic('more',16)+'</button>';
      if(S.dropdown==='member-'+m.id){
        h+='<div class="cdm">';
        h+='<button class="cdi" data-mrole="'+m.id+'" data-field="is_cared_one" data-val="'+(m.is_cared_one?'0':'1')+'">'+ic('heart',14)+' '+(m.is_cared_one?'Remove Cared One':'Mark as Cared One')+'</button>';
        if(!m.is_owner)h+='<button class="cdi" data-mrole="'+m.id+'" data-field="is_admin" data-val="'+(m.is_admin?'0':'1')+'">'+ic('shield',14)+' '+(m.is_admin?'Remove Admin':'Make Admin')+'</button>';
        h+='<div class="cdsep"></div>';
        if(!m.is_owner)h+='<button class="cdi dng" data-removemember="'+m.id+'">'+ic('trash',14)+' Remove from Group</button>';
        h+='</div>';
      }
      h+='</div>';
    }
    if(String(m.user_id)===String(UID))h+='<span class="cbadge cbo" style="font-size:.625rem">You</span>';
    h+='</div></div>';
  });
  h+='</div></div>';
  return h;
}

/* ── Post Actions ── */
function renderPostActions(p){
  const canEdit=String(p.author_id)===String(UID);
  const canPin=isAdmin()&&p.type==='announcement';
  const canDel=canEdit||isAdmin();
  if(!canEdit&&!canPin&&!canDel)return '';
  let h='<div class="cdrop"><button class="cbtn cb-ghost cb-icon" data-postmenu="'+p.id+'" style="width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem">'+ic('more',14)+'</button>';
  if(S.dropdown==='post-'+p.id){
    h+='<div class="cdm">';
    if(canEdit)h+='<button class="cdi" data-editpost="'+p.id+'">'+ic('edit',14)+' Edit</button>';
    if(canPin)h+='<button class="cdi" data-pinpost="'+p.id+'">'+ic('pin',14)+' '+(p.is_pinned?'Unpin':'Pin')+'</button>';
    if(canDel)h+='<button class="cdi dng" data-delpost="'+p.id+'">'+ic('trash',14)+' Delete</button>';
    h+='</div>';
  }
  h+='</div>';return h;
}

/* ── Dialogs ── */
function showDlg(type,data){S.dlg=type;S.dlgData=data||{};S.dropdown=null;render();}
function closeDlg(){S.dlg=null;S.dlgData={};render();}

function renderDialog(){
  if(!S.dlg)return '';
  let inner='';
  switch(S.dlg){
    case 'createGroup':
      inner='<h2 style="font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1rem">Create Care Group</h2>';
      inner+='<div class="sy4"><div><label class="clbl">Group Name *</label><input class="cinput" id="dlg-name" placeholder="e.g. Mom\'s Care Team"></div>';
      inner+='<div class="mt3"><label class="clbl">Description</label><textarea class="ctarea" id="dlg-desc" placeholder="What is this group for?" rows="3"></textarea></div>';
      inner+='<button class="cbtn cb-coral wf mt3" id="dlg-create">Create Care Group</button></div>';
      break;
    case 'joinCode':
      inner='<h2 style="font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1rem">Join Care Group</h2>';
      inner+='<div class="sy4"><div><label class="clbl">Join Code</label><input class="cinput" id="dlg-code" placeholder="Enter 6-character code" style="text-transform:uppercase"></div>';
      inner+='<button class="cbtn cb-coral wf mt3" id="dlg-join">Join Group</button></div>';
      break;
    case 'settings':
      var g=activeGroup();
      inner='<h2 style="font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1rem">Group Settings</h2>';
      inner+='<div class="sy4"><div><label class="clbl">Group Name</label><input class="cinput" id="dlg-sname" value="'+(g?g.name:'')+'"></div>';
      inner+='<div class="mt3"><label class="clbl">Description</label><textarea class="ctarea" id="dlg-sdesc" rows="3">'+(g?g.description:'')+'</textarea></div>';
      inner+='<div class="cbet mt3"><div><label class="clbl">Private Group</label><p style="font-size:.75rem;color:var(--M)">Private groups are hidden and invite-only</p></div>';
      inner+='<button class="csw'+(g&&g.is_private?' on':'')+'" id="dlg-spriv"></button></div>';
      if(g&&g.join_code){inner+='<div style="background:var(--MB);border-radius:var(--R);padding:.75rem" class="mt3"><label class="clbl" style="font-size:.75rem">Join Code</label><p style="font-size:1.125rem;font-family:monospace;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em">'+g.join_code+'</p><p style="font-size:.75rem;color:var(--M)">Share this code so others can join</p></div>';}
      inner+='<button class="cbtn cb-coral wf mt3" id="dlg-ssave">Save Changes</button>';
      if(isOwner()){inner+='<div style="border-top:1px solid var(--B);padding-top:1rem;margin-top:1rem"><h4 style="font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--DN);margin-bottom:.5rem">Danger Zone</h4>';
        inner+='<button class="cbtn cb-danger wf" id="dlg-sdelete">'+ic('trash',16)+' Delete Group</button></div>';}
      else{inner+='<div style="border-top:1px solid var(--B);padding-top:1rem;margin-top:1rem"><h4 style="font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--M);margin-bottom:.5rem">Membership</h4>';
        inner+='<button class="cbtn cb-outline wf" style="color:var(--DN);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.3)" id="dlg-sleave">Leave Group</button></div>';}
      inner+='</div>';
      break;
    case 'addTask':
      inner='<h2 style="font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1rem">Add Task</h2>';
      inner+='<div class="sy4"><div><label class="clbl">Task Title *</label><input class="cinput" id="dlg-ttitle" placeholder="e.g. Pick up medication"></div>';
      inner+='<div class="mt3"><label class="clbl">Description</label><textarea class="ctarea" id="dlg-tdesc" placeholder="Details..." rows="2"></textarea></div>';
      inner+='<div class="gr2 mt3"><div><label class="clbl">Priority</label><select class="csel" id="dlg-tpri"><option value="low">Low</option><option value="medium" selected>Medium</option><option value="high">High</option><option value="urgent">Urgent</option></select></div>';
      inner+='<div><label class="clbl">Category</label><select class="csel" id="dlg-tcat"><option>Daily Living</option><option>Medical</option><option>Transportation</option><option>Meals</option><option>Errands</option><option>Appointments</option><option>Emotional Support</option><option>Other</option></select></div></div>';
      inner+='<div class="gr2 mt3"><div><label class="clbl">Due Date</label><input class="cinput" type="date" id="dlg-tdue"></div>';
      inner+='<div><label class="clbl">Assign To</label><select class="csel" id="dlg-tassign"><option value="">Unassigned</option>';
      S.members.forEach(m=>{inner+='<option value="'+m.name+'">'+(m.name||'Member')+'</option>';});
      inner+='</select></div></div>';
      inner+='<button class="cbtn cb-coral wf mt3" id="dlg-tadd">'+ic('plus',16)+' Add Task</button></div>';
      break;
    case 'editPost':
      var ep=S.dlgData;
      inner='<h2 style="font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1rem">Edit Post</h2>';
      inner+='<div class="sy4"><div><label class="clbl">Title</label><input class="cinput" id="dlg-eptitle" value="'+(ep.title||'').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'" placeholder="Optional title"></div>';
      inner+='<div class="mt3"><label class="clbl">Content</label><textarea class="ctarea" id="dlg-epcontent" rows="4">'+(ep.content||'')+'</textarea></div>';
      inner+='<button class="cbtn cb-coral wf mt3" id="dlg-epsave">Save Changes</button></div>';
      break;
  }
  return '<div class="covl" id="dlg-overlay"><div class="cdlg">'+
    '<div class="cbet mb3"><div></div><button class="cbtn cb-ghost cb-icon" id="dlg-close">'+ic('x',16)+'</button></div>'+
    inner+'</div></div>';
}

/* ── Event Binding ── */
function bindMain(){
  // Close dropdowns on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    if(S.dropdown&&!e.target.closest('.cdrop')){S.dropdown=null;render();}
  },{once:true});
  // Tab switching
  document.querySelectorAll('.ctab').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){S.tab=this.dataset.tab;S.dropdown=null;render();});
  // Group switching
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-gid]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){S.gid=Number(this.dataset.gid);S.dropdown=null;loadGroupData().then(render);});
  // Header buttons
  const bs=document.getElementById('btn-settings');if(bs)bs.onclick=()=>showDlg('settings');
  const bj=document.getElementById('btn-join');if(bj)bj.onclick=()=>showDlg('joinCode');
  const bc=document.getElementById('btn-create');if(bc)bc.onclick=()=>showDlg('createGroup');
  // Home tab
  const hp=document.getElementById('home-post');if(hp)hp.onclick=function(){
    const c=document.getElementById('home-content'),t=document.getElementById('home-type'),v=document.getElementById('home-vis');
    if(c&&c.value.trim())createPost({content:c.value.trim(),type:t?t.value:'discussion',visibility:v?v.value:'group'});
  };
  // Announcements
  const ap=document.getElementById('ann-post');if(ap)ap.onclick=function(){
    const t=document.getElementById('ann-title'),c=document.getElementById('ann-content'),v=document.getElementById('ann-vis');
    if(c&&c.value.trim())createPost({title:t?t.value:'',content:c.value.trim(),type:'announcement',visibility:v?v.value:'group'});
  };
  // Tasks
  const at=document.getElementById('btn-add-task');if(at)at.onclick=()=>showDlg('addTask');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){toggleTask(Number(this.dataset.toggle),this.dataset.status);});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-deltask]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(e){e.stopPropagation();deleteTask(Number(this.dataset.deltask));});
  // Wishes
  const wp=document.getElementById('wish-post');if(wp)wp.onclick=function(){
    const c=document.getElementById('wish-content');if(c&&c.value.trim())createPost({content:c.value.trim(),type:'wish'});
  };
  // Messages
  const ms=document.getElementById('msg-send');if(ms)ms.onclick=function(){const i=document.getElementById('msg-input');if(i&&i.value.trim()){sendMsg(i.value.trim());}};
  const mi=document.getElementById('msg-input');if(mi)mi.onkeydown=function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'){const ms2=document.getElementById('msg-send');if(ms2)ms2.click();}};
  // Scroll messages to bottom
  const mscr=document.getElementById('msg-scroll');if(mscr)mscr.scrollTop=mscr.scrollHeight;
  // Gallery
  const ga=document.getElementById('gal-add');if(ga)ga.onclick=function(){const u=document.getElementById('gal-url'),c=document.getElementById('gal-cap');if(u&&u.value.trim())addGalleryItem(u.value.trim(),c?c.value:'');};
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-delgal]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){deleteGalleryItem(Number(this.dataset.delgal));});
  // Members - invite
  const is=document.getElementById('inv-send');if(is)is.onclick=function(){const e=document.getElementById('inv-email');if(e&&e.value.trim())inviteMember(e.value.trim());};
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-cancelinv]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){cancelInvite(Number(this.dataset.cancelinv));});
  // Member menus
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-membermenu]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(e){e.stopPropagation();const mid=this.dataset.membermenu;S.dropdown=S.dropdown==='member-'+mid?null:'member-'+mid;render();});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-mrole]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){const u={};u[this.dataset.field]=this.dataset.val==='1';updateMemberRole(Number(this.dataset.mrole),u);S.dropdown=null;});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-removemember]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Remove this member?'))removeMember(Number(this.dataset.removemember));S.dropdown=null;});
  // Post menus
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-postmenu]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(e){e.stopPropagation();const pid=this.dataset.postmenu;S.dropdown=S.dropdown==='post-'+pid?null:'post-'+pid;render();});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-editpost]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){const p=S.posts.find(pp=>String(pp.id)===this.dataset.editpost);if(p)showDlg('editPost',p);});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-pinpost]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){const p=S.posts.find(pp=>String(pp.id)===this.dataset.pinpost);if(p)updatePost(p.id,{content:p.content,title:p.title,is_pinned:!p.is_pinned});S.dropdown=null;});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-delpost]').forEach(el=>el.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Delete this post?'))deletePost(Number(this.dataset.delpost));S.dropdown=null;});
  // Cared ones buttons
  const aco=document.getElementById('btn-add-co');if(aco)aco.onclick=()=>toast('Use the Members tab to mark a member as "Cared One"');
  const aco2=document.getElementById('btn-add-co2');if(aco2)aco2.onclick=()=>toast('Use the Members tab to mark a member as "Cared One"');
  // Check-in submit
  const cis=document.getElementById('ci-submit');if(cis)cis.onclick=function(){toast('Check-in recorded ✓');};
  // Dialog bindings
  bindDialog();
}

function bindDialog(){
  const close=document.getElementById('dlg-close');if(close)close.onclick=closeDlg;
  const ov=document.getElementById('dlg-overlay');if(ov)ov.onclick=function(e){if(e.target===ov)closeDlg();};
  // Create group
  const dc=document.getElementById('dlg-create');if(dc)dc.onclick=function(){
    const n=document.getElementById('dlg-name'),d=document.getElementById('dlg-desc');
    if(n&&n.value.trim()){dc.disabled=true;dc.textContent='Creating...';createGroup(n.value.trim(),d?d.value:'').then(closeDlg).catch(e=>{toast('Error: '+e.message);dc.disabled=false;dc.textContent='Create Care Group';});}
  };
  // Join code
  const dj=document.getElementById('dlg-join');if(dj)dj.onclick=function(){
    const c=document.getElementById('dlg-code');
    if(c&&c.value.trim()){dj.disabled=true;dj.textContent='Joining...';joinByCode(c.value.trim()).then(closeDlg).catch(e=>{toast('Error: '+e.message);dj.disabled=false;dj.textContent='Join Group';});}
  };
  // Settings save
  const ss=document.getElementById('dlg-ssave');if(ss)ss.onclick=function(){
    const n=document.getElementById('dlg-sname'),d=document.getElementById('dlg-sdesc'),p=document.getElementById('dlg-spriv');
    if(n&&n.value.trim()&&S.gid){updateGroup(S.gid,{name:n.value.trim(),description:d?d.value:'',is_private:p?p.classList.contains('on'):false}).then(closeDlg);}
  };
  const sp=document.getElementById('dlg-spriv');if(sp)sp.onclick=function(){this.classList.toggle('on');};
  const sd=document.getElementById('dlg-sdelete');if(sd)sd.onclick=function(){if(confirm('Delete this group? This cannot be undone.')){deleteGroup(S.gid).then(closeDlg);}};
  const sl=document.getElementById('dlg-sleave');if(sl)sl.onclick=function(){
    if(confirm('Leave this group?')){const m=curMember();if(m)removeMember(m.id).then(()=>{S.gid=null;loadGroups().then(()=>{closeDlg();render();});});}
  };
  // Add task
  const ta=document.getElementById('dlg-tadd');if(ta)ta.onclick=function(){
    const t=document.getElementById('dlg-ttitle'),d=document.getElementById('dlg-tdesc'),p=document.getElementById('dlg-tpri'),c=document.getElementById('dlg-tcat'),dd=document.getElementById('dlg-tdue'),a=document.getElementById('dlg-tassign');
    if(t&&t.value.trim()){ta.disabled=true;createTask({title:t.value.trim(),description:d?d.value:'',priority:p?p.value:'medium',category:c?c.value:'',due_date:dd?dd.value:'',assigned_to:a?a.value:''}).then(closeDlg).catch(e=>{toast('Error');ta.disabled=false;});}
  };
  // Edit post
  const ep=document.getElementById('dlg-epsave');if(ep)ep.onclick=function(){
    const t=document.getElementById('dlg-eptitle'),c=document.getElementById('dlg-epcontent');
    if(c&&c.value.trim()&&S.dlgData.id){updatePost(S.dlgData.id,{title:t?t.value:'',content:c.value.trim()}).then(closeDlg);}
  };
}

/* ── Init ── */
init();
})();
